description: Lists the business's tests (A/B experiments): each with its id, name and hypothesis, the variable tested, the surface (paid, organic, email, page), state, variants, who started it, when it started and was decided, and for a decided one its result (the winning variant, its lift, the p value, both samples and the threshold it had to clear). simulated true marks a rehearsal on made-up numbers, which is never evidence. Use it to say what was tested and what won; start a new one with experiment_start, and cite a decided one in learning_write.

project.description: The project's id or exact name. Optional when the account has one project.

state.description: running: still collecting; decided: a winner was called; all: both.

name: experiments_list
title: Experiments list
